question: Which papers show that prism cache invalidation causes stale shards and that epoch pinning prevents the stale-shard failures?
expected_answer_points: prism cache invalidation causes stale shards

candidate_papers.title: Prism cache invalidation stale-shard failures
candidate_papers.text: Prism cache invalidation causes stale shards when leases expire during mirror promotion. The study reports stale-shard failures after invalidation races.

candidate_papers.title: Epoch pinning for prism cache leases
candidate_papers.text: Epoch pinning prevents prism stale-shard failures by holding cache leases through mirror promotion until every shard observes the new epoch.

candidate_papers.title: Prism prefetch citation appendix
candidate_papers.text: This near-miss citation discusses prism cache prefetch timing and names stale shards, but it does not test invalidation races or epoch pinning.

candidate_papers.title: Shard audit partial evidence note
candidate_papers.text: A shard audit observes stale records after lease churn, but it does not identify prism cache invalidation as the cause and gives no epoch-pinning mitigation.

candidate_papers.title: Epoch counters for log compaction
candidate_papers.text: Epoch counters compact append-only logs and mention cache leases only as unrelated implementation background.
